remarks: Spacious Half Duplex in Greenwich This well-appointed 3-bedroom, 2.5-bathroom home offers the perfect blend of comfort and convenience. The updated kitchen flows seamlessly into the bright and inviting living and dining areas, complete with a cozy fireplace and sliders leading to a private patio-perfect for relaxing or entertaining.  Additional features include an in-unit washer and dryer, a large attic for ample storage, and parking for up to three vehicles (1 garage space + 2 reserved spots).  Located in a prime spot, this property is just a short walk to public transportation, including the Port Chester train station. It's also minutes from I-95, shopping centers, restaurants, parks, libraries, and the beach.  Please note: No pets allowed.  Don't miss this opportunity-schedule your visit today!
